fixtures.facts: Grouchos Gregor won the third semi-final in 35.36sec for trainer Kelly Wilton. Aayamza Legend won the second in 35.75 and Bubbly Holly the first in 35.95; Newinn Jolly was withdrawn with a urine infection.

fixtures.basis: ICC men's ODI team rating from icc-cricket.com; difference divided by a 40-point scale
fixtures.facts: Afghanistan are eighth on 93 ODI rating points and Zimbabwe eleventh on 65. Sediqullah Atal made 102 from 110 balls in Afghanistan's 158-run win over Zimbabwe on 19 October, and Rashid Khan took 4/17.

fixtures.comp: India Women v Zimbabwe Women, first ODI
fixtures.basis: ICC women's ODI team rating from icc-cricket.com; difference divided by a 40-point scale
fixtures.facts: India Women are third on 124 rating points and Zimbabwe Women twelfth on 14. Smriti Mandhana holds the top spot in the ICC women's ODI batting rankings on 790 points.
